title: Escalation Routing Rule R-005: Pre-auth pending over 48 hours
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-005 -- Pre-auth pending over 48 hours
TRIGGER TYPE: Time Threshold
CONDITION: Pre-auth unacknowledged after 48h
ROUTE TO: Insurance and TPA (Extension 1029)
QUEUE: QUEUE_INSURANCE
PRIORITY: HIGH
SLA: 2.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Unreasonable insurer delay threatening planned admission. Escalate to Senior Insurance Officer.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Preauth for UHID-000002 has had no response for 2 days
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Status still submitted after 50 hours
source_citation: SMCH Escalation Routing Matrix -- R-005 (Pre-auth pending over 48 hours) v1.0
